zones.name: Ledeberg
zones.text: A deelgemeente of Ghent outside the historic core. Ghent publishes crime figures by wijk and by month as open data, and its police report two consecutive years of decline: 31,074 recorded offences in 2025, down 3,418 or 10% on 2024. Pickpocketing fell from 1,026 cases to 564 — a drop of 45% — and burglaries, bicycle thefts and thefts from cars all fell sharply too. Snatch thefts went from 168 to 122. The city's per-wijk open data exists but was not read area by area for this review, so no separate finding is claimed here. The dashed outline says that plainly.

zones.name: Gent
zones.text: The historic core — Gravensteen, the Graslei, Sint-Baafs — and where visitors stay. Ghent publishes crime figures by wijk and by month as open data, and its police report two consecutive years of decline: 31,074 recorded offences in 2025, down 3,418 or 10% on 2024. Pickpocketing fell from 1,026 cases to 564 — a drop of 45% — and burglaries, bicycle thefts and thefts from cars all fell sharply too. Snatch thefts went from 168 to 122. The one thing the police do localise is shoplifting, and its hotspots are exactly the shopping streets: Veldstraat, Korenmarkt and Langemunt. For a visitor that means crowds and shops rather than risk. This is a green that rests on published figures moving in the right direction, not on an absence of news.
